baseline_models.focus_anchor: Words 2-4 bind favors, the dual addressees' Lord, and an active declaration of falsity into one question.
baseline_models.mechanism: Bestowal is presented as evidence of owning and nurturing lordship; the dual addressees are not asked whether gifts exist in the abstract but which of these evidentiary gifts they will actively invalidate.

activation_trace.role: Bestowed favors supplies the question's ordinary evidentiary objects.
Ownership and authority make the favors attributable acts rather than ownerless benefits.
Repair, nurture, and completion make benefaction an ongoing formative process.
Declaring a report or giver false makes denial an active attribution, not passive ignorance.

changed_reading.before: A general rhetorical question about blessings.
changed_reading.after: A two-party recognition test asking which concrete acts of the owning, nurturing Lord the addressees will actively invalidate.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The focus noun permits capacity and shortfall activations, while the final verb permits a charge that proves false by not being carried through.
baseline_models.mechanism: A favor can be read as furnished ability. Denial then occurs performatively when a capacity is withheld, left undeveloped, or made to fail its charge; nurture names the intended movement toward completion.

activation_trace.role: Ability turns favors into capacities placed at the addressees' disposal.
Falling short supplies the failure mode by which a furnished capacity is withheld or delayed.
Stagewise nurture supplies the intended development from capacity to completion.
A charge that proves false by failing to continue makes denial visible in conduct.

changed_reading.before: Denial is only saying that received favors are unreal.
changed_reading.after: Denial can be enacted by making bestowed capacities fall short of the completion for which they were nurtured.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The focus roots jointly permit oath, pact, and fulfilled-or-failed charge images.
baseline_models.mechanism: The question can carry a covenantal undertone: the Lord's bestowals bind their recipients, and the recipients make that bond false when they fail to carry its answering obligation through.

activation_trace.role: Oath-making supplies a binding rather than merely consumable aspect of the focus noun.
A covenant or protection pact turns lordship into an attached relation of fidelity.
Fulfilling or failing a charge supplies the mechanism by which a bond is verified or made false.

changed_reading.before: Favors are benefits that invite assent.
changed_reading.after: Favors also behave like bindings whose truth is tested by whether their recipients answer them faithfully.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening sequence makes recognition itself a mercy-built capacity: teaching gathers and transmits, creation furnishes the recognizer, and articulation discloses distinctions. The focus challenge therefore tests a cultivated faculty, not an evidentiary vacuum.

activation_trace.role: Active false-attribution is the refusal that the opening recognition system makes accountable.
Mercy and tenderness supply the originating disposition of the teaching sequence.
A thing becoming disclosed to a knower makes teaching an event of recognition.
Gathering and collection make revelation a coordinated body of signs rather than isolated data.
Bringing the creature into being supplies the recipient in whom recognition can occur.
Disclosing meaning by speech or sign gives the recognizer a means to articulate what has been shown.

structural_cues: 55:1-4 orders mercy, teaching, creation, and articulation before the material and cosmic signs.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: mercy, teaching, gathered recitation, creation, and disclosure occur in sequence. Reader arrow: these acts jointly cultivate the faculty whose refusal counts as denial; live alternative: they are separate opening favors without a single epistemic pipeline.

changed_reading.before: The refrain confronts addressees with external benefits.
changed_reading.after: The refrain also confronts them with the mercifully produced ability to gather, distinguish, and name evidence, making denial a refusal of a capacity already taught.

context_deltas.mechanism: Cosmic calculation descends into commanded social measurement. Truth is not merely spoken: it is enacted by keeping measure aligned, while short-weighting makes the ordered gift prove false in one's own conduct.

activation_trace.role: A charge succeeds or fails through performance, turning denial into a practical test.
Counting and calculation establish a calibrated cosmic order.
The scale of justice transfers calibration from celestial pattern to human dealing.
Equity supplies the norm that a truthful weighing must realize.
Short-changing a measure supplies the concrete act that falsifies calibrated order.

structural_cues: 55:5-9 moves from celestial reckoning to a balance, a prohibition against excess, and an imperative to weigh justly.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: calculation, balance, equity, and short measure form a descending sequence. Reader arrow: corrupt measure is an enacted form of the focus verb; live alternative: the balance passage is only another favor later denied verbally.

changed_reading.before: To deny is to call the Lord's favors false.
changed_reading.after: To deny is also to falsify the world's calibrated gift by reproducing it as an unjust measure.

context_deltas.mechanism: Fruit, sheath, generative grain, expendable husk, and aromatic leaf form a production cycle. Favor shifts from a finished pleasant object to a layered ecology in which enclosure and residue are functional stages of yield.

activation_trace.role: The plant-name branch gives the focus noun a materially botanical activation.
Stagewise nurture organizes the plant details as a process of becoming.
Pleasant fruit supplies the visible consumable yield.
The plant vessel and fruit sheath make concealment a productive enclosure.
Seed that sprouts and bears grain supplies recursive generativity.
Crumbled husk and crop leaf supply the apparently residual stage that protects and accompanies grain.
Aromatic plant and leaf extend yield beyond visual fruit into scent and foliage.

structural_cues: 55:11-12 moves from fruit to sheath to seed to husk to aromatic vegetation before the first refrain.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: consumable yield is presented with enclosure, seed, husk, and leaf. Reader arrow: the non-fruit stages are integral favors because they enable the cycle; live alternative: the verses simply inventory separate products.

changed_reading.before: A favor is the finished item one enjoys.
changed_reading.after: A favor can be the whole hidden-to-visible production cycle, including coverings and residue that make the enjoyed yield possible.

context_deltas.mechanism: Two domains are released into encounter without transgressive collapse, and something hidden emerges from them. The favor is thus not only either domain or its product but the governed interface that permits contact while preserving productive difference.

activation_trace.role: Bestowed favor receives the newly activated form of a productive boundary condition.
Administration and completion supply governance of the interface.
Being sent freely supplies motion rather than static separation.
Two opposing things arriving together supplies actual contact at the interface.
Transgressing a limit supplies the collapse that the boundary prevents.
Bringing something out of concealment supplies the interface's emergent yield.

structural_cues: 55:19-22 orders release, encounter, nontransgression, and emergence; refrains at 55:21 and 55:23 bracket condition and yield.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: moving domains meet, do not exceed, and yield something emergent. Reader arrow: regulated difference enables the yield and is itself a favor; live alternative: boundary and yield are parallel signs with no causal arrow between them.

changed_reading.before: The favors are identifiable things bestowed by the Lord.
changed_reading.after: Some favors are governed relations: limits that preserve difference while allowing contact to bring concealed value out.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context sharply separates what disappears from what remains. The milk-that-does-not-last branch of the focus verb exposes a hidden criterion of denial: treating a gift as false because its duration failed one's expectation.

activation_trace.role: Bestowed favors remain favors even when their temporal spans differ.
Milk disappearing rather than lasting supplies the concrete image of an expectation judged false by expiry.
Cessation after a period of remaining supplies genuine finitude rather than mere illusion.
Continuance supplies the contrasting category against which finite gifts are mismeasured.
The face or facing future directs persistence toward the Lord rather than toward every bestowed object.

structural_cues: 55:26-28 places universal passing, the remaining face of the Lord, and the refrain in immediate succession.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: finite things cease while the Lord-facing term remains. Reader arrow: recipients may call a finite benefit false because they expected permanence; live alternative: the contrast concerns ontology only, not a psychology of disappointed duration.

changed_reading.before: A vanished benefit appears to have failed its promise and can be discounted.
changed_reading.after: The refrain challenges the expectation that only a permanent gift is true: finitude can belong to the gift while persistence belongs to its Lord.

context_deltas.mechanism: The capacity activation of the focus noun is bounded by passage that succeeds only with compelling warrant and granted power. A limit can be a favor because it distinguishes real capacity from imagined autonomy and directs ability through authorization.

activation_trace.role: Ability supplies the focus-side question of what capacity has actually been furnished.
Lordship and authority locate capacity within governance rather than autonomous possession.
Clean passage to the other side supplies the attempted action whose conditions are tested.
Compelling warrant supplies an evidentiary condition for passage.
Granted power and jurisdiction supply the operative condition for passage.

structural_cues: 55:33 addresses the same human-jinn pair as a collective dual and repeats the passage verb around an exception of warrant or power.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: crossing is repeatedly attempted and conditioned on warrant or power. Reader arrow: the condition and limit expose gifted rather than autonomous capacity and can themselves count as favor; live alternative: the verse is solely a threat of inescapability.

changed_reading.after: A favor may delimit and authorize ability, revealing which capacities are real, answerable, and able to pass through.

context_deltas.mechanism: After questioning is removed, recognition proceeds by visible marks and seizure for fault. The denial verb no longer governs only disputable speech; conduct has written a sign that identifies its bearer without a counterclaim.

activation_trace.role: Declaring another false supplies the speech-act model that embodied evidence overtakes.
Recognition through an effect or sign makes identity inferable rather than verbally negotiated.
A visible marking supplies the embodied evidence by which the bearer is known.
Being taken to account for fault turns the readable mark into consequence.

structural_cues: 55:39 removes questioning; 55:41 recognizes by marks and seizes; the refrain at 55:40 and 55:42 encloses that reversal from speech to legibility.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: no questioning is followed by recognition through marks and taking for fault. Reader arrow: prior denial has become self-authenticating embodied evidence; live alternative: the marks identify independently of any relation to the repeated denial speech.

changed_reading.before: Denial remains a proposition that could be asserted or defended.
changed_reading.after: Denial can become a legible state: the addressee's enacted answer marks the body before any verbal defense is requested.

context_deltas.mechanism: Branching, two springs, flowing provision, and paired fruit repeat pairing at several scales. With a responding-voice branch active in the focus noun and the refrain itself repeated, the dual addressees become not only observers of pairs but a pair summoned to answer in sequence.

activation_trace.role: A voice following another voice gives the focus question an antiphonal response potential.
A branching extension supplies plurality generated from a shared source.
A source of running water supplies each garden's paired outflow.
Continuous flowing gives the paired sources a common dynamic.
Pleasant fruit supplies the domain in which pairing becomes directly consumable.
A counterpart joined to its mate makes pairedness an explicit organizing relation.
The immediately prior recurrence supplies an actual answering voice for the focus recurrence to follow.

structural_cues: Two gardens, branching forms, two springs, two kinds of every fruit, and dual morphology accumulate immediately before 55:53.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: paired entities and a repeated dual-address refrain cluster around the focus. Reader arrow: ecological pairing recruits the two addressees into a paired call-and-response; live alternative: the dual only names two audiences and the repetition has no antiphonal force.

changed_reading.before: The dual audience jointly receives a repeated question.
changed_reading.after: The paired world recruits the paired audience into an antiphonal test: one recurring voice follows another, and the hearers must supply the truthful counterpart.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later equation of good action with good return supplies the missing directional relation in the covenant baseline. Bestowal calls for a fitting enacted answer; denial makes the relation false by refusing reciprocity rather than merely misdescribing the gift.

activation_trace.role: Oath-like binding makes benefaction capable of carrying an answering obligation.
Covenant or protection pact supplies the relational frame for reciprocity.
A charge that succeeds only when carried through supplies covenant verification by action.
Answering an act with its recompense supplies reciprocal direction.
Goodness as a good act makes both sides of the correspondence performative.

structural_cues: 55:60 poses a reciprocity question and 55:61 immediately answers it with the refrain's second question.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: enacted good is paired with recompensing good. Reader arrow: the repeated challenge asks whether recipients will sustain that reciprocal bond; live alternative: 55:60 describes reward without imposing an obligation on the recipient.

changed_reading.before: The covenantal reading has a bond but no clear mode of answering it.
changed_reading.after: The bond becomes reciprocal: received good asks for enacted good, and denial is the failure to let benefaction generate its fitting response.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing name, stable growing good, and response of satisfaction recast favors as marks that make their source nameable. The refrain's opposite is not bare assent but a satisfied answering recognition that lets effects bear the Lord's name.

activation_trace.role: Bestowed favors supply the effects through which their source can be recognized.
False attribution supplies the negative act that severs effect from source.
A name as designation makes the source explicitly nameable at closure.
A visible mark that makes a thing known turns each favor into a sign-bearing effect.
Stable, growing good condenses the many favors into an enduring generative quality.
An answer of satisfaction supplies a positive response opposed to repeated denial.

structural_cues: 55:78 closes on the Lord's name and honor after the final refrain.
The branchless majesty root at 55:78 is retained only as a structural closure cue; no mapped root or branch is assigned to it.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: the close joins naming, stable growing good, honor, and an available satisfied-answer branch. Reader arrow: favors function as marks that carry the source's name and invite that answer; live alternative: the close is doxological without retroactively defining the refrains.

changed_reading.before: The refrain asks for assent to a list of benefits.
changed_reading.after: The refrain asks whether sign-bearing benefits will be falsely detached from their source or answered by naming their Lord with satisfied recognition.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The deceptive-cloth branch is form-distant and surprising, but it is anchored in the focus denial root and is immediately activated by bedding whose inner lining is named. Render only as a surface-versus-interior formal analogy, never as a lexical translation of the focus verb.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Word 4 can activate appearance that misreports its condition, while the question asks the addressees to judge what truly counts as favor.

activation_trace.role: A variegated cloth whose appearance deceives supplies the surface misreport.
A good-looking but bitter-tasting shrub supplies a second mismatch between appearance and experienced value.
Bedding and furnishing supply the material surface under judgment.
A garment's inner lining supplies the concealed layer that can overturn surface appraisal.

changed_reading.before: Denial misstates a proposition about an obvious gift.
changed_reading.after: Denial may be a surface judgment that misclassifies value because it cannot read the hidden lining or the difference between pleasing appearance and actual taste.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The running-animal idiom is remote from ordinary denial, yet it is anchored in the focus root and fits the refrain's observable interruption of flowing description. Render as a rhythmic reading strategy, not as the verb's translation or an animal claim about the verse.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus verb closes a recurrent line that repeatedly arrests the surah's descriptive movement.

activation_trace.role: Running a stage and then stopping to look behind supplies the refrain's retrospective braking image.
Flowing and coursing supply the forward descriptive motion that the refrain interrupts.
Following in sequence makes the prior refrain a formal predecessor whose wake the focus occurrence occupies.

changed_reading.before: The refrain repeats a fixed accusation between descriptions.
changed_reading.after: Each recurrence can function as a deliberate stop-and-look-back, arresting the running sequence so the hearer reassesses the signs just passed.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: Reading a favor as a liability that follows its holder is legally and morphologically distant, but the split focus mapping, covenant branch, failed-charge branch, and later settling of a claim form a coherent anchored mechanism. Preserve it as an obligation analogy, not as doctrine or direct translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus's favor, Lord-relation, and denial roots can align as benefit, attached bond, and failed discharge.

activation_trace.role: A liability or right that follows its holder turns receipt into an attached claim.
Covenant and protection pact identify the relation within which the claim persists.
Failure to carry a charge through supplies default on the attached claim.
Settling and fully collecting a debt supplies the later image of discharge.

changed_reading.before: A favor is exhausted when the recipient receives it.
changed_reading.after: A favor can leave a claim that follows its recipient: its truth remains to be discharged through an answering act.

strongest_changes: Denial moves from disputed speech to calibrated conduct: unjust measure makes ordered benefaction false in practice.
Favors expand from finished objects to enabling systems, including learned recognition, productive coverings, governed boundaries, and authorized limits.
The local density of pairs and repeated refrains activates an antiphonal reading in which the dual audience must become the truthful counterpart to the paired world.
Finitude no longer disqualifies a gift; the perish/remain contrast exposes duration-expectation as one possible engine of denial.
summary.what_was_special: Split and non-dominant mappings kept several live mechanisms visible: capacity and shortfall, oath and attached claim, following voices, rhythmic arrest, deceptive surface, and name-bearing marks. These coexist with the strong favor-recognition reading rather than replacing it.
remaining_uncertainties: The oath, liability, antiphonal, botanical, cloth, and running-then-stopping activations are branch-backed but form-distant; they should remain explicitly exploratory.
Causal arrows from boundary to yield, teaching to accountable recognition, and finite duration to disappointed denial are abductive reader contributions, not directions stated by the packet.
The branchless majesty root contributes only to the structural force of the close and cannot support a branch citation.
